title: HiLo-Token: Input-Adaptive High-Low Frequency Token Compression for Efficient Image Editing
abstract: arXiv:2606.13898v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Creative image editing tools, such as Photoshop's Remove or Generative Fill buttons, are central to everyday customer use and account for a major share of traffic in Photoshop and Lightroom. However, current generative AI models face significant latency challenges, which become even more pronounced when transitioning from convolution-based U-Nets to Diffusion Transformers (DiTs). In our evaluation on hundreds of representative image editing samples spanning a wide range of mask ratios, the DiT module alone accounts for an average of 73% of the total model latency, even after being distilled from 50 timesteps down to 8 timesteps. translated_abstract: 创意图像编辑工具，例如Photoshop的“移除”或“生成式填充”按钮，是日常用户使用的核心功能，占据了Photoshop和Lightroom的主要流量份额。然而，当前的生成式AI模型面临显著的延迟挑战，当从基于卷积的U-Net过渡到扩散Transformer（DiT）时，这一挑战变得更加突出。在我们对数百个涵盖广泛掩码比例的代表性图像编辑样本的评估中，即使DiT模块已经从50个时间步蒸馏压缩到8个时间步，它仍然占总模型延迟的平均73%。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了HiLo-Token，一个输入自适应的token压缩框架，它为高频、上下文丰富的区域分配更多的token预算，同时为低频区域分配更少的token。具体而言，对于用户掩码指定的编辑区域，我们保留……
tldr: 提出HiLo-Token，一种输入自适应的token压缩框架，通过为高频上下文丰富区域分配更多token、为低频区域分配更少token，显著降低基于扩散Transformer的图像编辑延迟。
en_tdlr: HiLo-Token, an input-adaptive token compression framework that allocates more tokens to high-frequency, context-rich regions and fewer to low-frequency areas, significantly reduces latency in Diffusion Transformer-based image editing.
